Before You Apply
To be considered for admission into a graduate degree program, professional program, or certificate program, you must have:
A bachelor’s degree from a regionally accredited institution of higher education in the United States or a foreign institution of acceptable standing
Adequate undergraduate preparation in the proposed major field or equivalent evidence of an appropriate background for undertaking an advanced degree program
A Completed Online Application Includes:
Application fee paid online at the time of application submission.
Personal statement
Letters of Recommendation – Review each program’s requirements, but a minimum of two letters of recommendation from instructors, employers, supervisors or other professional colleagues must be submitted through the online admissions system. Hard copies will not be accepted.
For International applicants – please click here for additional requirements.
College transcripts from all institutions attended — Unofficial transcripts are sufficient for completing an application to the URI Graduate School. Foreign unofficial transcripts must be in English or translated by a translator. Official transcripts from all schools attended are required if admitted to the program.
Applicants from URI who are only applying to URI do not need to send official transcripts. Instead, contact us directly after the URI degree has been conferred and we will validate your transcripts.
Official electronic transcripts may be sent via Credentials Solutions, Parchment, and National Student Clearinghouse. Please be sure to designate the University of Rhode Island – Graduate Admissions so that we may receive the transcripts.
Official paper transcripts should be sent to the mailing address below. Foreign, non-evaluated official transcripts must be in English, or translated by a certified translator, and sent in a sealed envelope directly from the original institution or translator to:
ATTN: Admission Office
URI Graduate School
55 Lower College Road, 204 Quinn Hall
Kingston, RI 02881
For applicants in PTCAS, CSDCAS, DICAS, find mailing addresses here.
Contact the Graduate Admission Office with any questions at gradprocessing@etal.uri.edu or by phone at (401) 874-3554.
